U.S. Financial, economic, and banking history. # Revisiting Professional Forecasters’ Past Performance and the Outlook for 2026. The consensus outlook for real GDP growth in 2026 is 1.9%, but it seems that forecasters have considerable disagreement on the outlook for the year ahead, as reflected in the following:. *   The average of the top 10 GDP growth rate forecasts is 2.5%, while the average of the bottom 10 forecasts is 1.2%.
